title: The train had been cancelled

lines.en: Mina, I’m sorry I’m late. When I got to the station, the train had been cancelled.
lines.pt: Mina, desculpe o atraso. Quando cheguei à estação, o trem tinha sido cancelado.

lines.en: Oh no! So had you been told about it, or did you find out on the platform?
lines.pt: Ah, não! Então avisaram você antes, ou você descobriu na plataforma?

lines.en: Nobody had been told. The announcement had only been made two minutes before.
lines.pt: Ninguém tinha sido avisado. O anúncio só tinha sido feito dois minutos antes.

lines.en: Typical! Last month my train had been delayed for an hour, and we weren’t given any information.
lines.pt: Típico! No mês passado meu trem tinha sido atrasado em uma hora, e não nos deram nenhuma informação.

lines.en: By the time I left, the whole platform had been filled with angry passengers.
lines.pt: Quando saí, a plataforma inteira já tinha sido tomada por passageiros irritados.

lines.en: So how did you get here? Had the buses been affected as well?
lines.pt: Então como você chegou aqui? Os ônibus também tinham sido afetados?

lines.en: Yes, several buses had been cancelled because the roads had been flooded overnight.
lines.pt: Sim, vários ônibus tinham sido cancelados porque as ruas tinham sido alagadas durante a noite.

lines.en: Then I’m impressed you came at all. Had a refund been offered to you?
lines.pt: Então estou impressionada por você ter vindo. Ofereceram reembolso a você?

lines.en: Yes, a clerk said that all fares would be refunded, and a form had been added to the website.
lines.pt: Sim, um atendente disse que todas as passagens seriam reembolsadas, e um formulário tinha sido colocado no site.

lines.en: Good. I had expected problems, because the tracks had been repaired only last week.
lines.pt: Ótimo. Eu esperava problemas, porque os trilhos tinham sido consertados só na semana passada.

lines.en: Exactly! Anyway, I’m here now, and I’ll buy the coffee.
lines.pt: Exatamente! Enfim, estou aqui agora, e eu pago o café.

facts.label: Past perfect passivo
facts.sub: Tinha sido cancelado: had been cancelled. Ninguém tinha sido avisado: nobody had been told. Pergunta: Had you been told?

facts.label: Tinha sido cancelado
facts.sub: Had been + particípio é o passivo do past perfect. The train had been cancelled significa que o cancelamento foi anterior a outro momento. Em português, “tinha sido cancelado”. Use quando o foco é a coisa, não quem fez.

facts.label: Ninguém tinha sido avisado
facts.sub: Nobody had been told usa o passivo com um pronome negativo. Também podemos dizer We hadn’t been told. A pergunta é Had you been told? e a resposta curta é Yes, I had ou No, I hadn’t.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “The train had been cancelled” is a passive past perfect sentence.
We form it with had + participle only.
We use it when the action came before another past moment.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “The train had been cancelled” is a passive past perfect sentence. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We form it with had + participle only. → Falso (We use had been + participle.)
We use it when the action came before another past moment. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A morning of cancelled trains · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a wet Friday morning at Bristol Temple Meads station. Hundreds of people look up at the departure screens. Bia waits outside a small coffee stand with two cups. Her friend Anya runs in, out of breath. The morning has not gone as planned. Anya starts to explain what had happened.

“Bia, I’m sorry I’m late. When I got to the station, the train had been cancelled.” says Anya. “Oh no! So had you been told about it, or did you find out on the platform?” says Bia. “Nobody had been told. The announcement had only been made two minutes before.” says Anya.
